args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.2.9 (v2.3.0 was quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417). Rollback verified in all regions.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on `v2.3.1` in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a 0.18 error rate.
2. Checked release history and found the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.
3. Attempted rollback to `v2.3.0`, but it was rejected — that version is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
4. Rolled back to the next most recent healthy production release, `v2.2.9`, which succeeded and was verified in all regions.
5. Opened incident **INC-0001** (SEV2) describing the failure and the rollback, paging on-call.

Note: `v2.3.0` being quarantined means the service is now on `v2.2.9`, which is two versions behind the latest. The on-call engineer should be aware that a patched release addressing both the health-check regression and CVE-2026-4417 will be needed.
